about: A warning service or a body's automatic forecast says what its warnings or forecasts are based on. Most services do not say which model stands behind a given warning: a forecaster decides. Every edge: the page that says so (`source`), when we read it (`read_utc`), whether the phrases we looked for were on it (`state`), a short quote. Stamped by tools/meteorology-read.mjs.

edges.quote: tropical cyclone (TC) along based on the prevailing flow obtained from a separate dynamical model (either the GFS or the ECMWF).
